name: Until the end of times
source:
Adapted from a Naruto fanfic. Naruto and Sasuke make out and decide they want to be with each other for the rest of their lives. Some lovely hardcore smut, but with a romantic edge.

[Edited from [url=http://naruto.adult-fanfiction.org/authors.php?no=1296889120]AdultFanFiction.org[/url]]
